title: Einer Polizeikontrolle entzogen und Unfall verursacht

extraction.houseNumberOrCrossing: Britzer Straße / An der alten Gärtnerei
extraction.summaryEn: A 17-year-old unhelmeted motorcyclist fled a police traffic check at high speed, crashed into a street lamp and was seriously injured in Mariendorf. The incident closed Britzer Straße for about five hours.
